question.text: Meera invests Rs.5,000 per month from age 30 to age 60 at an expected return of 12% per annum. What is the approximate corpus she will accumulate?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Series XVII p.23, Rs.5,000 per month invested for 30 years at 12% per annum gives Rs.1,74,74,820. Using FV(12%/12, 360, -5000, 0, 0) confirms this figure. The Trap: Rs.93,94,233 is the corresponding 25-year value at the same rate per p.23. Rs.1,13,02,439 corresponds to a lower return rate. Always check the rate and period carefully. Note: Both the 30-year (Rs.1,74,74,820) and 25-year (Rs.93,94,233) figures used here are taken directly from the Series XVII workbook p.23 illustration.
